title: Railway Block Signalling Interlocking
description: A railway line is divided into blocks. Signals between blocks show red or green. The interlocking only lets a signal show green if this cannot lead to two trains in the same block.

requirements.text: The line is divided into blocks. At most one train may be in a block at any time.
Each signal stands at the end of one block (its approach block) and protects entry into another block (its protected block). A signal shows either red (stop) or green (proceed).
A signal may only show green if the block it protects is free.
At most one of the signals protecting the same block may show green at a time.
A train may only pass a signal that shows green. The train then moves from the signal's approach block into its protected block, and the signal returns to red automatically.
The signaller can request a signal to show green. The interlocking refuses the request, and reports why, if granting it would violate R3 or R4.
The signaller can set any signal to red at any time.
Trains enter the line only at entry blocks and leave only from exit blocks. A train can only enter if the entry block is free and no signal protecting it shows green.
Initially, the line is empty and all signals show red.

declarations.name: approach
declarations.comment: The block in which a train waits at the signal.

declarations.name: protected
declarations.comment: The block the signal grants entry to.

predicates.formula: ∀ s : SIGNAL • approach s ≠ protected s
predicates.comment: A signal leads from one block into a different block.

declarations.name: at
declarations.comment: The block each train on the line is in. Since the function is injective, no two trains are in the same block.

declarations.name: aspect
declarations.comment: What each signal shows. Total: every signal always shows something.

predicates.formula: ∀ s : SIGNAL • aspect s = green ⇒ protected s ∉ ran at
predicates.comment: A green signal protects a free block.

predicates.formula: ∀ s₁, s₂ : SIGNAL • aspect s₁ = green ∧ aspect s₂ = green ∧ protected s₁ = protected s₂ ⇒ s₁ = s₂
predicates.comment: No two green signals lead into the same block.

schemas.name: ClearSignal
schemas.comment: The signaller requests a signal to show green. If it is green already, nothing changes.

predicates.formula: ∀ s : SIGNAL • s ≠ s? ∧ protected s = protected s? ⇒ aspect s = red

schemas.name: SetRed
schemas.comment: No precondition: setting a signal to red is always safe.

schemas.name: PassSignal
schemas.comment: A train passes a signal, as reported by the track sensors. The precondition describes the movements this specification allows. A train passing a red signal is outside the specification.

predicates.comment: The train is waiting at the signal.
The signal returns to red behind the train.

predicates.formula: ∀ s : SIGNAL • protected s = b? ⇒ aspect s = red
predicates.comment: No other train has been allowed into the entry block.

predicates.formula: ∃ s : SIGNAL • s ≠ s? ∧ protected s = protected s? ∧ aspect s = green
